description: 2026-11-06: a full troll walks home to a hub on the far side of a cliff of the given `kind` (small / medium / high / mountain), `up` or down. Finds the cliff in the loaded terrain, takes the player and the troll there, builds the hub on the far side, fills the backpack and waits for the unload. With `forced` the troll is sent over the LEDGE WALK at once (stt.forceLedge) and the walk must arrive. Leaves the troll as tag `troll`; the ledge counters are logged as the last step.
